# Anne Baker Partners in Health

> Movement coaching for older adults in South Georgian Bay, Ontario, and online anywhere.

I am Anne Baker, a certified personal trainer and a Pilates and yoga specialist. Most of the people I work with are older adults who want to move with less pain, keep their strength, and stay independent. I also teach mobility for mature paddlers.

## Contact
- Phone: 705-441-2258
- Email: bakerford@sympatico.ca
- Website: https://annebakerpartnersinhealth.com/
- Also works out of Active Life Conditioning: https://activelifeconditioning.com/team/anne-baker/
